description: This file defines the Matrix class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for matrix operations such as transpose, index, and vector checks, used in spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: Provides static methods for matrix operations in spreadsheet calculations, including transpose, index, and vector checks.

methods.name: isColumnVector
methods.description: Checks if an array of values is a column vector.

methods.name: isRowVector
methods.description: Checks if an array of values is a row vector.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Retrieves a value or array of values from a matrix based on row and column indices, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: extractRowValue
methods.description: Helper method to extract a row or entire matrix based on row index.
